dominant_strengths: Confident display headline pairs cleanly with italic subhead, giving the demo a calm editorial cadence.
Restrained dark palette with semantic dot indicators communicates toast types without resorting to loud chip backgrounds.
Trigger grid is symmetric and well-proportioned, with the 'show all four' CTA acting as a clear secondary tier.
dominant_weaknesses: Static screenshot reveals nothing about stacking, motion, or timing — the actual product of the brief is invisible here.
Composition floats mid-page with vast empty void above and below, wasting canvas without intentional negative-space tension.
Buttons feel generic Tailwind-default; no distinctive treatment, hover affordance, or visual link to a forthcoming toast region.
fix_priorities: Show at least one stacked toast in the corner so the screenshot delivers on the brief's core promise.
Tighten vertical composition or add ambient context (timer, dismiss, progress) to fill the void purposefully.
Differentiate the four triggers with subtle tonal accents matching their dot color for stronger semantic mapping.
Introduce a hairline or label for the toast spawn region to hint at motion direction and anchor the interaction.
rationale.norman_balance: Visceral is muted by emptiness, behavioral is clear from labeled triggers, reflective is weak because the design's signature artifact — the stack — is absent.
rationale.intent_fit: Partially — it's a clean launcher panel for toasts, but the screenshot omits the actual notification stack that defines the brief.
